nodes.label: Expr
nodes.desc: Base expression object with execute, compile and pipe.

nodes.label: Table
nodes.desc: Relational expression with filter, aggregate, join and exporters.

nodes.label: Column
nodes.desc: Columnar value expression with string, numeric and temporal methods.

nodes.label: Node
nodes.desc: Immutable traversable base of every operation in the IR.

nodes.label: Relation
nodes.desc: Base operation for relational algebra over tables.

nodes.label: Project
nodes.desc: Column selection and derived-expression projection.

nodes.label: Filter
nodes.desc: Row predicate application in the IR.

nodes.label: Aggregate
nodes.desc: Group-by metrics with grouping keys and reductions.

nodes.label: JoinChain
nodes.desc: Composable join representation with link references.

nodes.label: InMemoryTable
nodes.desc: Memtable operation holding client-side data.

nodes.label: Literal
nodes.desc: Typed constant value leaf in the IR.

nodes.label: WindowFunction
nodes.desc: Analytic op pairing a reduction with a window frame.

nodes.label: Deferred
nodes.desc: Chainable placeholder powering the _ lambda syntax.

nodes.label: Pattern
nodes.desc: Declarative match and replace patterns over the graph.

nodes.label: EGraph
nodes.desc: Equivalence-graph store with rewrites used in join analysis.

nodes.label: Concrete
nodes.desc: Immutable annotated base class for operations and datatypes.

nodes.label: DataType
nodes.desc: Core datatype hierarchy such as Timestamp, Struct and Array.

nodes.label: Schema
nodes.desc: Ordered mapping of column names to datatypes.

nodes.label: cast
nodes.desc: Implicit and explicit datatype coercion rules.

nodes.label: SQLGlotCompiler
nodes.desc: Generic sqlglot lowering with visit_ methods per operation.

nodes.label: DuckDBCompiler
nodes.desc: DuckDB dialect specialization of the SQLGlot compiler.

nodes.label: PostgresCompiler
nodes.desc: PostgreSQL dialect specialization with server UDF support.

nodes.label: DataFusionCompiler
nodes.desc: DataFusion dialect specialization of the SQLGlot compiler.

nodes.label: Select
nodes.desc: Restates projects, filters and sorts as SQL SELECT structure.

nodes.label: DuckDB Backend
nodes.desc: Connection wrapper that runs compiled SQL on DuckDB.

nodes.label: DuckDBPyArrowData
nodes.desc: Result converter tuning Arrow output from DuckDB.

nodes.label: Polars Backend
nodes.desc: Connection wrapper executing native polars LazyFrames.

nodes.label: translate
nodes.desc: singledispatch lowering of operations to polars expressions.

nodes.label: DataFusion Backend
nodes.desc: Connection wrapper executing SQL on Apache DataFusion.

nodes.label: DataMapper
nodes.desc: Base protocol for converting backend payloads to Python frames.

nodes.label: PyArrowData
nodes.desc: Arrow-centric result conversion shared by exporters.

nodes.label: PyArrowTableProxy
nodes.desc: Wraps Arrow tables as ingestible in-memory sources.

nodes.label: simplify
nodes.desc: Rule passes that reorder and collapse filter/project chains.

nodes.label: to_sql
nodes.desc: Bridges SQL text and expressions via to_sql and parse_sql.
